inlines.v: CONDENSATE, verb transitive [See Condense.] To condense; to compress into a closer form to cause to take a more compact state; to make more dense. CONDENSATE, verb intransitive To become more dense, close or hard. CONDENSATE, adjective Made dense; condensed; made more close or compact.
